FL-091.label: When a judge fails a swarm, its feedback is saved as new packets and a new swarm is sent out, looping until every judge is satisfied.

FL-091.observed: Run 3: round 1 failed with feedback (no candidate), the feedback became round 2's charge, round 2 passed unanimously and merged. Run 2 looped two rounds and stopped with its reason.

FL-094.observed: Deliberation in chat (charter, walls, signature), the unattended run, then the judges' review, which sent runs 2 and 3 round again; the signed charter re-renders signed and locked (FL-094-run5-signed-locked.png) and filled after a block (captures/FL-094-signed-charter-after-block*.png).
